evals.name: fresh-full-project
evals.prompt: I want to start a new VisualForge project. Reference site is https://linear.app — I like how calm and precise it feels, the dark surfaces, tight typography and the subtle motion. Target page: just the homepage for now. Our brand is 'Tidewater', a project-planning tool for small architecture studios. Audience is studio principals and project leads. Call the project tidewater. Viewports default is fine. I approve the brief as described, go ahead and run the full workflow.
evals.expected_output: Project workspace projects/tidewater/ with brief.md and valid state; preflight recorded; Gate A recorded approved; mode full; research stage invoked or, because stage skills are not installed, reported as blocked with a remedy; no fabricated research artifacts; project report written.
assertions: Workspace projects/tidewater/ created with brief.md
Project state file exists and is valid JSON
Gate A (brief approval) recorded as approved in state
Browser actually probed (navigate/snapshot), not judged from loaded tool schemas
Tool preflight recorded in state (browser + node checks)
No research output written without browser evidence on disk
Final response explains research is blocked because the reference-analyzer skill is missing
Project report written to the project root
No Next.js app scaffolded

evals.name: resume-interrupted-project
evals.prompt: Can you resume the harbor project? My laptop died yesterday in the middle of the run, no idea where it got to.
evals.expected_output: Lock acquired, reconcile run; interrupted S2b-design-system detected and marked failed; S1-research and S2a-ux kept as completed (not re-run, outputs unchanged); the retry of S2b is attempted or reported blocked because design-system-extractor is not installed; user told what was found; project report updated.
files: fixture: projects/harbor with S1 and S2a completed, S2b running
assertions: Completed S1/S2a outputs left byte-identical (not re-run or rewritten)
Interrupted S2b-design-system no longer marked 'running'
S1-research and S2a-ux still marked completed in state
Final response tells the user the design-system stage was interrupted
Final response says research and UX analysis were kept / not repeated
Orchestrator lock released at the end
Project report written to the project root

evals.name: research-only
evals.prompt: just want research for now, no design or build. reference is https://stripe.com/payments - look at how they structure the page, their type and colour system and the scroll animations. project name stripe-study, page = payments page. brand placeholder 'Ledgerly' (fintech for freelancers).
evals.expected_output: Project created in research mode with only S0/S1 in scope; brief written; run stops at Gate A asking for approval (user did not approve) or, if treated as approved, S1 attempted/blocked; no stages beyond S1 started; no design/spec/site artifacts created.
assertions: Workspace projects/stripe-study/ created with brief.md
Browser actually probed (navigate/snapshot), not judged from loaded tool schemas
State records research-only mode
Final response asks the user to approve the brief before research starts
No analysis/design/spec/site artifacts created
No research output written without browser evidence on disk
Project report written to the project root

evals.name: browser-unavailable
evals.prompt: New VisualForge project 'meridian' from https://vercel.com, homepage only, brand 'Meridian Freight' (logistics dashboard for regional carriers). Brief approved, run it end to end. (Environment note: the Playwright MCP server is not connected in this session, so the mcp__playwright__* browser tools are unavailable.)
evals.expected_output: Preflight records browser unavailable and reports which stages it blocks; S1-research reported blocked (browser_unavailable or missing skill) with remedy; no fallback to WebFetch/curl to produce 'observations'; no research artifacts fabricated; project report explains the blocker and next step.
assertions: State records the browser tools as unavailable
Final response says research and visual QA are blocked by the missing browser
Final response tells the user how to fix it (connect/enable Playwright MCP)
No WebFetch/curl fallback used to inspect the reference
No research artifacts written
Project report written to the project root
No Next.js app scaffolded
